keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Hassani Dotson (Seattle Sounders FC).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Penalty saved. Albert Rusnák (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot saved in the bottom left corner by Rafael Cabral (Real Salt Lake).
Dominik Marczuk (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Seattle Sounders FC 1, Real Salt Lake 0. Albert Rusnák (Seattle Sounders FC) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Sebastian Gomez.
Morgan Guilavogui (Real Salt Lake) is shown the yellow card.
Kim Kee-Hee (Seattle Sounders FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
